thought.text: Connection restored. All 10 containers are up and healthy (backend spring-app, keycloak, postgres, meilisearch, localstack, etc.). CMS and boards frontends are serving through the proxy (200). The app dev server got OOM-killed while the boards build ran (this machine has only 7.6GB RAM — insufficient for 3 concurrent Angular dev servers plus all containers). Let me restart the app dev server (its build is now cached):

reasoning_content:
The connection has been restored. The state of the stack is as follows:
- All 10 containers are running and healthy (including spring-app backend, keycloak, postgres, meilisearch, localstack, etc.)
- Dev servers: app (38489) is down, cms (45423) is running, boards (43781) is running
- Via proxy: app -> 502, cms -> 200, boards -> 200

The app's dev server went down again (memory pressure — the boards build was running while app and cms were running). The machine only has 7.6GB RAM, and it's not enough to run 3 Angular dev servers and all the containers simultaneously. The boards build consumed the memory, and it looks like the app dev server got killed (OOM).

Let me restart the app's dev server to bring all three frontends back up. I'll do it in a way that doesn't trigger OOM. Since the build is now cached, memory usage should be lower.

Let me check the app's logs and restart it.

action.command:
tail -6 /workspace/.urbo/workspace/logs/app.log; echo "=== oom check ==="; dmesg 2>/dev/null | grep -i "oom\|killed" | tail -2
cd /workspace
export GITHUB_TOKEN="ghp_dummytesttoken0000000000000000000000"
export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-21-openjdk-amd64; export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
rm -f /tmp/fa2.log
setsid nohup bash -c 'exec just serve --apps=app < /dev/zero' > /tmp/fa2.log 2>&1 &
echo "app serve pid $!"

tool_call.arguments:
{"command": "tail -6 /workspace/.urbo/workspace/logs/app.log; echo "=== oom check ==="; dmesg 2>/dev/null | grep -i "oom\|killed" | tail -2

rm -f /tmp/fa2.log
setsid nohup bash -c 'exec just serve --apps=app < /dev/zero' > /tmp/fa2.log 2>&1 &
echo "app serve pid $!"", "summary": "Restart app dev server after OOM"}

summary: Restart app dev server after OOM
